summary_en: FY2027 interim dividend raised to 16.25 yen and year-end dividend to 30.00 yen per share from prior forecast of 13.75 yen interim and 27.50 yen full-year, reflecting higher consolidated earnings driven by increased fund margins at subsidiary Ikeda Senshu Bank.
title_en: Notice Regarding Modification of Full-Year Business Performance Forecast and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Senshu Ikeda Holdings has increased its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The year-end dividend per share is raised to 16.25 yen from the previously announced 27.50 yen full-year forecast, bringing the total annual dividend to 30.00 yen. The interim dividend of 16.25 yen remains as previously predicted.

The increase is driven by upward revision of full-year consolidated earnings. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders is now forecast at 20.7 billion yen, up 1.6 billion yen from the prior forecast of 19.1 billion yen. This improvement reflects stronger-than-expected performance at subsidiary Ikeda Senshu Bank, where fund margins have expanded due to rising interest rates and credit-related expenses are expected to be lower than initially anticipated.

The revised dividend reflects the company's shareholder return policy targeting a payout ratio of approximately 40 percent. Management raised the full-year dividend forecast based on consolidated earnings upgraded to 32.2 billion yen in ordinary profit from 28.5 billion yen, an increase of 3.7 billion yen.
